I have been calling from 8:30 am onwards to try to secure an appointment. Each time, I have had to wait a long time. I selected the callback option, and although I received a callback later, I was again kept waiting for a long time before being connected. When I finally spoke to someone, I was told that there were no appointments left and that I should call back the next day and repeat the same process.

However, when we tried calling from another phone to book an appointment on the same day, an appointment was offered. This inconsistency is very concerning and unfair.
I would appreciate it if you could look into this matter and improve the booking system, as the current process is very stressful and
